kiel-fehmarn-baltic-long-day.story: A bigger sea-air day for stable weather and daylight. The best part sits around Hohwacht bay view, Fehmarn bridge view, Eutin return lake, while Heiligenhafen harbour keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.
